speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: To combat this scam variant, the Singapore Police Force (SPF) has been working with Meta to stop further abuse of compromised WhatsApp accounts as soon as they are detected.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The SPF have also been working with online platforms, including Google, to introduce stronger safeguards to mitigate the risk of fraudulent takeover of online messaging accounts, such as through the preemptive detection and blocking of URLs linked to phishing websites.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The Government can also require designated online service providers to introduce upstream measures to safeguard against the misuse of online accounts.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Ultimately, however, the best defence against scams is a vigilant and discerning public.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: To this end, the Government has been running campaigns to encourage the public to adopt good cyber practices.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: For instance, the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA) recently launched the fifth edition of the National Cybersecurity Campaign, which aims to raise awareness and drive adoption of good cyber practices.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The SPF and CSA also work with other agencies on more targeted campaigns, such as the SG Cyber Safe Students Programme, which supports schools in the conduct of cybersecurity lessons.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: In addition, the SPF regularly highlights emerging scam variants and the measures that the public can take to protect themselves.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: First, "Add" security features, such as enabling two-step verification, on your WhatsApp and other online messaging accounts.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Turn on your notification settings to be alerted to changes to linked devices.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Second, "Check" that you are on the official WhatsApp website.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Check your settings for unauthorised linked devices and be wary of unusual requests from your contacts whose accounts may have been compromised.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Third, "Tell" your friends and family about your scam encounters and report any fraudulent activity to your bank and to the Police immediately.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: She mentioned earlier about the collaboration between the SPF and Meta in terms of combating these WhatsApp phishing scams.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Apparently, many of my colleagues and I, we do use such services because of its ease.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: Could the Minister of State elaborate on the effectiveness of the measures that have been taken so far to reduce future compromised accounts since its implementation?

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: For my second supplementary question, the Minister of State mentioned earlier about the collaboration with Google in terms of enhancing pre-emptive detection and blocking of URLs linked to phishing sites.

speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
text: I know this is common, but are there any measurable outcomes of this initiative so far?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: First, I would like to share that the platforms have responded with varying degrees of urgency and they had leaned to it to different extents.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: They need to respond more quickly to our requests, to be more effective and efficient in recovering compromised WhatsApp accounts and disabling the service if it is part of a scam.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, the Government will continue to engage these online platforms since they are key vectors for the propagation of scams.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: For Google, as we all know, they run a search engine.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: So, we are working with them so that they can be more proactive and also more capable at detecting links which are links to phishing websites.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And this is something that requires technical work on Google's end.

speaker: Mr Speaker
